dedupe_keys.name: cityjson json encoding of the citygml data model

description: CityJSON is a JSON-based encoding for 3D city models, also called digital maquettes or digital twins, that implements a subset of the OGC CityGML 3.0 data model. It aims to be compact and developer-friendly: files are on average seven times smaller than CityGML-XML, conversion both ways is possible with citygml-tools, and a web viewer, validator and the cjio tool for merging, filtering, reprojecting and texture handling are provided. Version 2.0 is an official OGC standard (document 20-072r5), and the latest specification is 2.0.2. News on the site includes FlatCityBuf, a cloud-optimised CityJSON (July 2025, with C++, Python and TypeScript support in August 2026), and a media type for CityJSONSeq. Coverage: any city; the site lists open datasets. Access: specifications and schemas on the website and GitHub. Licence: given in the specifications repository, not read on the day; free. Caveats: a few rarely used CityGML features are not supported. Simulation uses are lightweight exchange of 3D building models for energy, solar and flood modelling and web digital twins. Related records: OGC CityGML and 3DCityDB.
